verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships its own user-facing feedback widget. It installs with a single script tag ('Nothing to build'), and submissions are routed to a project or the org Feedback list through a settings page. However, it is an embedded widget, not a standalone public portal, and it still has to be added to the site's code, so a PM likely needs some engineering involvement. missing for 10: a standalone hosted public feedback portal or board, a documented no-code setup path a PM can complete alone, portal customization or branding, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can set up a public-facing feedback portal without engineering help

citations.quote: Your users press it, describe a problem, and send — without leaving the page or filing anything anywhere.
One tag, and we serve the widget... Nothing to build, and published fixes reach your site without you redeploying.
Add a single script tag with your widget key.
Pick a project on that page and submissions route to that project.
